HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   C. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   C. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.

3. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   C. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   C. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.
   C. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   D. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.

9. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   C. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.

10. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   C. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.
   C. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elections in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain National integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Human Developments in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A — Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. D — Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A — Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. D — Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. D — Nairobi

7. D — Explain symbols used on a map

8. A — Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. C — Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. C — Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. D — Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. B — Plan income and spending wisely

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elections in Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of National integration; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Human Developments in Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
